name: West African Griot
description: Hereditary verbal specialists responsible for historical narration, genealogy, praise, critique, diplomacy, and musical performance. They are the foundational ancestral node of the oral rhythmic continuum.

name: The Last Poets
description: A collective of poets and musicians who arose from the Black Civil Rights movement. Their politically charged, rhythmic spoken-word over minimal drum backing heavily influenced the cadence and subject matter of early MCing.
